launches.title: Capveon — AI for finding, understanding, and winning government work
launches.tagline: AI for finding, understanding, and winning government work for manufacturers and contractors
launches.body:
<https://youtu.be/xpwCDcgNo-E>
Hey YC! We're Finn and Brison, the founders of Capveon (YC F26).

**Capveon is AI for finding, understanding, and winning government work for manufacturers and contractors.**

Across America, thousands of public infrastructure projects are planned, designed, and built every year. Water treatment plants, highways, power systems, industrial facilities, and everything in between.

Behind these projects are thousands of businesses competing to make them happen. Manufacturers supplying equipment, distributors connecting buyers and suppliers, and contractors doing the work.

But finding and winning this work is surprisingly difficult.

Project information is scattered across federal, state, and local agencies, engineering firms, procurement portals, capital improvement plans, and technical specifications. By the time a project goes out to bid, months or even years of planning and specification decisions may have already happened.

And finding a project is only half the battle.

Teams still have to sift through hundreds of pages of technical specifications, figure out whether their products or capabilities are relevant, track changes and addendums, and coordinate with engineers, suppliers, and contractors to put together a winning bid.

**We're building Capveon to make that entire process easier.**

Capveon uses AI to help teams:

* **Find:** Discover relevant government projects, including opportunities years before they go out to bid.
* **Understand:** Analyze engineering specifications, bid documents, and project requirements to identify where their products and capabilities fit.
* **Win:** Track opportunities, stay on top of project changes, and coordinate the information needed to pursue work all the way through award.

We're starting with manufacturers and contractors in critical infrastructure, particularly water and wastewater, heavy civil construction, and industrial projects.

Longer term, we see the same problems across energy, defense, and other industries where complex technical requirements, fragmented information, and long procurement cycles make winning work difficult.

Our goal is simple: help the companies building the physical world spend less time searching for information and more time winning work.

**The future won't build itself.**

Check us out at <https://capveon.ai>

If you're a manufacturer, distributor, or contractor pursuing government projects, we'd love to talk!
